exam_scheme.note: Odisha Teacher Eligibility Test (OTET) is conducted by the Board of Secondary Education (BSE), Odisha, Cuttack, adhering to NCTE guidelines for determining statutory eligibility for appointment as teachers in elementary schools (Classes I to VIII) across Odisha. The examination comprises two distinct papers: Paper-I for Primary Teachers (Classes I to V) and Paper-II for Upper Primary Teachers (Classes VI to VIII). Each paper consists of 150 multiple choice questions carrying 150 marks for a duration of 2.5 hours (150 minutes). All questions in non-language areas are bilingual in Odia and English. There is no negative marking.
